title: Senior / Staff AI Platform Engineer
description_html:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).




ABOUT THE ROLE

Suno's song creation agent is becoming something other teams build on. As a Senior AI Platform Engineer, you'll build the APIs, SDKs and shared tooling, including eval infrastructure, tracing and model routing, that let engineers across Suno ship agent features faster. You'll work closely with the agent team, partner teams and Infra, and your customers are other engineers, so adoption is a measure of success. You'll help shape the platform as it grows.
Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/bxgQXsn06Vz3KKEn




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build the platform APIs and SDKs that other teams use to build agent features.

 - Develop shared eval infrastructure, including the eval runner, results storage and dashboards, and help the team decide what to build and what to buy.

 - Implement end-to-end tracing and observability, so any request can be followed across services from prompt to audio.

 - Manage model provider routing, fallback, rate limits and cost controls.

 - Partner with engineering teams across Suno to onboard them onto the platform with docs and hands-on support, and with Infra on the reliability and scale of the agent runtime.

 - Help more people turn ideas into music by making it faster and safer for teams across Suno to ship agent features.
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL NEED




MUST-HAVES

 - 4–6 years building and scaling backend or platform systems in production, in any language.

 - Experience on a team that supports other developer teams, including building a platform, API or SDK that other teams adopted.

 - Experience with production LLM or agent systems, for external or internal users.

 - Depth in distributed systems and observability, including tracing across services.

 - Comfort working with internal customers: scoping with partner teams, earning adoption and handling ambiguity.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Experience building an eval or tracing product.

 - Experience running LLM gateway or model routing infrastructure.

 - Experience writing SDKs that other teams use.

 - Experience with Python backends.


WORK LOCATION POLICY

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno SF office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Listen to the Suno version of this role! https://suno.com/s/bxgQXsn06Vz3KKEn




ADDITIONAL NOTES

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.




PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)
   
   


COMPENSATION

 - $228K- $363K



Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. title: Senior Infrastructure Security Engineer – EDA Clusters
description_html: Securing NVIDIA's EDA clusters is not a matter of deploying a standard security stack. The workloads are too large, too long-running, and too performance-sensitive for an off-the-shelf playbook to simply apply. That constraint is the job. You'll be an individual contributor on Infrastructure Security Engineering for EDA Clusters, the team that implements security controls across the compute, storage, and networking that NVIDIA's hardware engineers design silicon on - spanning on-prem data centers and multi-cloud. You will sit alongside the engineers who run these clusters 24x7, close enough to deploy a control, investigate a behavior, and change the running environment yourself.   This is hands-on build work, not control review. You'll decide where conventional tooling applies, where it actively cannot, and then engineer the alternative. If your depth is in large-scale compute, networking, or storage infrastructure at a hyperscaler, a security product company, or anywhere fleets and fabrics are the day job, and you've carried real accountability for the security properties of those systems, you're who we want to talk to. We don't expect fluency in every security product category. We expect you to own outcomes and pick up the remaining domain breadth fast. Security engineering here is engineering: code, instrumentation, and secure-by-default infrastructure - not tickets, exceptions, and spreadsheets.    What You'll Be Doing:    Build and operate security controls and telemetry for EDA compute, storage, and networking - design, ship to production, then own them.  Engineer around hard constraints. Protect multi-day, high-value compute jobs without degrading them. Where heavyweight in-node agents are not viable, build the workable answer instead.  Make the network and platform the control plane. Protection can't depend solely on what runs inside the node.  Instrument for detection. Collect and normalize security signals from the fleet into our SIEM, and build the detections and dashboards that turn it into something actionable. Log collection alone is not monitoring.  Investigate and respond. Chase down EDA-specific threats and exposure, and execute containment and remediation hands-on with infrastructure and service owners.  Automate enforcement and evidence. Infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code so secure configuration is the default state, with compliance evidence produced as an engineering output rather than a manual exercise.  Run the lifecycle of the security technologies you own: selection, rollout, operation, and eventual replacement.  Work across boundaries. Partner directly with data center operations, IT storage and networking, network engineering, CSP teams, and NVIDIA's central security organization on shared outcomes.  Think like an adversary. Threat modeling and mitigation planning across network, storage, and compute.     What We Need To See:    8+ years of hands-on infrastructure or infrastructure-security engineering across on-prem and cloud environments.  Strong Linux depth - you are comfortable at the system level, not just the console level.  Real experience operating or securing compute fleets at scale: provisioning, lifecycle, and the operational realities of long-running jobs.  Working networking expertise applied to large compute environments.  Programming/scripting fluency (Python, Go, or shell) used for automation, detection, and tooling you've shipped and maintained.  Solid foundations in access control, authentication, segmentation, encryption, and vulnerability lifecycle.  A track record of landing changes with partners who don't report to you.  Clear written and verbal communication - credible with individual engineers and with leadership.  A Bachelor's degree in a relevant engineering field or equivalent experience.     Ways To Stand Out from the Crowd:    Security or platform engineering inside EDA, HPC, or large research-cluster environments.  Breadth across security domains - IAM, EDR/XDR, CNAPP, CSPM, zero-trust architectures - or a demonstrated pattern of picking up new domains fast.  Built or operated infrastructure security capabilities at a hyperscaler or a security product company - you engineered detection and enforcement systems rather than deploying someone else's.  Experience with kernel- and fabric-level observability and enforcement - eBPF, in-line and out-of-band inspection, DPU/SmartNIC offload - as an alternative to heavyweight in-node agents.  Contributions to open-source security or infrastructure tooling.    Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most forward-thinking and talented people in the world working for us and, due to outstanding growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD - 356,500 USD for Level 5.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 24, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
